reasons: The rule's fallback expressly conditions acceptance of any non-solicit on carve-outs for general advertisements and unsolicited approaches; Section 13 contains neither, so the clause fails the fallback on a material term rather than a minor sub-element — deviation is the correct classification.

The redline is purely additive: it appends the two customary carve-outs and leaves scope ('direct involvement with the Services'), the one-year duration, and the solicitation-based (non no-hire) construct untouched. This is the smallest edit that reaches the fallback.

The high changed-character ratio (0.784) is an artifact of adding a new sentence to a short paragraph, not a rewrite; the 'duration ≤ 12 months' check failure is a phrasing artifact ('one (1) year' spelled out and retained unchanged).

Comment is accurate, in-tone, cites the playbook position, and correctly acknowledges that scope and duration are acceptable; the rationale properly notes the measure-from-termination variance as a non-redlined minor point.
